owner_toolbox_instruction.authority_limit: Authorizes bounded implementation and lawful integration under current protection; does not change Formal Current, required checks, R2 exceptions, scientific status, or external permissions.

owner_c1_replacement_instruction.authority_limit: C1 replaces the prior keep-forever assumption with evidence-based replacement, specialization, retirement, or COMPARISON_UNKNOWN.

blueprint_binding.narrow_scope: Predecessor/as-of binding; evidence, scope and declared-state delta; source-family delta; declared change reason; visible acquisition dependence; update/stopping policy and evaluator identity.
blueprint_binding.prior_result_limit: The broad AB-03 synthetic pilot showed no meaningful net benefit over a bounded narrative; this candidate preserves the narrower machine-readable update-delta gap only. This source binding does not upgrade AB-15 backlog status.

overlap_audit.evidence_lineage_delta: Existing self-correction output is triggered by repository source-asset changes and carries a fixed SOURCE_ASSET_CHANGED state; it does not compare two caller-bound research acquisition snapshots, stopping policies, evaluator instruments, or acquisition dependence.
overlap_audit.evidence_program_validator: Validates one fixed checked-out Evidence Program tree; it does not compare temporal snapshots.
overlap_audit.publication_metadata_comparator: Compares selected title/year fields between Crossref and OpenAlex results for one DOI; it does not compare evidence updates for a claim across as-of snapshots.
overlap_audit.audit_finding_comparator: Compares caller-declared audit findings under one shared target; it does not track evidence acquisition, claim scope, update policies, or source-family deltas.

implementation_boundary.filesystem_access: stdin/stdout only; no repository or user-file reads/writes
implementation_boundary.rollback: Remove the isolated candidate card, implementation, schemas, docs, fixture, tests and evidence, then regenerate the human and machine identity projections; preserve source history and validation outcomes.
